title: A new algorithmic approach for finding flat minima: critically damped Polyak stepsizes
abstract: arXiv:2611.26475v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present a new adaptive stepsize rule that biases gradient descent toward flatter minima in both theory and practice, and establish the first uniform-in-time guarantees for both sharpness and loss reduction for a broad class of locally quadratic objectives. Our critically damped Polyak (CDP) stepsizes multiply the classical Polyak rule by $4$ and a mild damping factor. The factor $4$ is critical in that it produces equioscillations around the manifold of minimizers $\mathcal{M}$ to leading order. Damping provably drives convergence to $\mathcal{M}$. CDP thus operates at the edge of stability by adapting its stepsizes to local curvature. Once the loss is small, its projected iterates follow gradient descent on $\log{\lambda_1(\nabla^2 \mathcal{L})}$ along $\mathcal{M}$ to leading order, paralleling the flatness bias of normalized gradient descent (Arora et al., 2022). translated_title: 一种寻找平坦极小值的新算法方法：临界阻尼Polyak步长
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种新的自适应步长规则，它在理论和实践上都使梯度下降偏向更平坦的极小值，并首次为一大类局部二次目标函数建立了关于锐度和损失下降的时间一致保证。我们的临界阻尼Polyak（CDP）步长将经典的Polyak规则乘以 $4$ 和一个温和的阻尼因子。因子 $4$ 至关重要，因为它在主导阶上产生围绕极小值流形 $\mathcal{M}$ 的等幅振荡。而阻尼因子则可证明地驱动迭代收敛到 $\mathcal{M}$。因此，CDP通过使步长自适应于局部曲率，在稳定性的边缘运行。一旦损失变得足够小，其投影迭代在主导阶上沿着 $\mathcal{M}$ 执行关于 $\log{\lambda_1(\nabla^2 \mathcal{L})}$ 的梯度下降，这与归一化梯度下降的平坦性偏好相呼应（Arora et al., 2022）。与归一化梯度下降不同，CDP的步长会随……（摘要此处截断）而收缩。
tldr: 本文提出临界阻尼Polyak（CDP）自适应步长——将经典Polyak规则乘以4并加温和阻尼——使梯度下降偏向更平坦的极小值，并首次为局部二次目标函数建立了锐度与损失下降的时间一致理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes critically damped Polyak (CDP) stepsizes—obtained by multiplying the classical Polyak rule by 4 with mild damping—that bias gradient descent toward flatter minima and provide the first uniform-in-time guarantees on sharpness and loss reduction for locally quadratic objectives.
